title: Change displayed site name/label to “ClashRoyaleHub” (no spaces)

requirements.text: Update all user-visible branding text that currently shows the site name as "Clash Royale Hub" so it displays exactly "ClashRoyaleHub" (no spaces), including the header brand label and the HTML document title.

quotes: It didn’t work the link still stayed the Same I want the links name changed to ClashRoyaleHub

acceptanceCriteria: The header brand/button text displays exactly "ClashRoyaleHub" on all pages.
The browser tab/document title displays exactly "ClashRoyaleHub".
Any page copy that refers to the site name (e.g., About page mission text) uses "ClashRoyaleHub" (no spaces).
There are no remaining user-visible instances of the exact string "Clash Royale Hub" used as the site name anywhere in the frontend.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not change Internet Identity/authentication behavior.
Do not implement any mechanism to bypass network restrictions, paywalls, or access controls (no “unblocked” gameplay).
nonGoals: Changing the actual deployed URL/canister domain or any external link destinations (only the displayed site name/label should change).
